name: lv2
desc: Portable plugin standard for audio systems
why: The LV2 audio plugin standard is a fascinating ecosystem, but as a spec it is more plumbing than a playable toy.

brief.what_it_is: LV2 is an extensible open standard for audio plugins, described on its homepage as a simple core interface plus extensions that add more advanced features. The homepage says it can be used to build audio effects, synthesizers, and control processors for modulation and automation. The homepage does not describe concrete inputs or outputs; it is a portal to the specification, docs, and a download of LV2 1.18.10. The Homebrew entry lists an executable named lv2_validate, which I did not see documented on the page.
brief.why_it_exists: The homepage presents LV2 as a portable, open plugin standard that adds features such as platform-native UIs, network-transparent plugin control, portable and archivable persistent state, non-realtime tasks with sample-accurate export, and semantic control with meaningful units. The 'Why LV2?' page likely gives the fuller framing, but I did not fetch it.
brief.install_notes: Nothing beyond the Homebrew formula was visible on the homepage. The page offers a 'Download LV2 1.18.10' link, and the Homebrew entry names lv2_validate as an executable. I saw no hardware, account, runtime, or first-run steps.
brief.standout: The standard is built around a small core with optional extensions, and it targets features that most plugin formats leave out, such as network-transparent control and archivable state. The Homebrew scout note calls it a fascinating ecosystem, but that is an outside note and not something the homepage claims.
brief.status: maintained, as far as I can tell: the homepage advertises a current release, LV2 1.18.10, with a download link. I could not see a release date or last commit from the homepage alone, so the exact recency is unknown.
brief.caveats: I only read the homepage. The Homebrew scout note says LV2 is more plumbing than a playable toy, which is a fair warning: the page is a spec portal with no demo, screenshots, or getting-started commands. The homepage says the spec and code are permissively licensed and support all major platforms, but it gives no details. The Repository and documentation links were not followed, so I cannot report build requirements or the exact license text.
quotes: LV2 is an extensible open standard for audio plugins.
LV2 has a simple core interface, which is accompanied by extensions that add more advanced functionality.
The LV2 specification and accompanying code is permissively licensed free software, with support for all major platforms.
fetch_log: https://lv2plug.in/ - fetched successfully; a text version of the homepage with navigation items (Documentation, Why LV2?, Developing with LV2, LV2 Specifications, Host Compatibility, News, Community, Repository, Issues) but no link targets were shown, so I did not follow further links.
